T2M.name: Air temperature
T2M.definition: The average temperature of the air about two metres above the ground, where people live and weather stations measure.

T2M_MIN.name: Coldest temperature of the month
T2M_MIN.definition: The lowest air temperature reached during each month, two metres above the ground. It usually happens on a clear, calm night.

PRECTOTCORR.name: Rain and snow
PRECTOTCORR.definition: The depth of rain and melted snow reaching the ground, averaged per day over each month.
PRECTOTCORR.dataset: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 reanalysis, bias-corrected precipitation), monthly mean

IMERG_PRECIP.name: Rain and snow (satellite)
IMERG_PRECIP.definition: The depth of rain and melted snow reaching the ground, estimated from a network of satellites and corrected with rain gauges, averaged per day over each month.
IMERG_PRECIP.dataset: GPM IMERG Final Run monthly V07 (GPM_3IMERGM), area average over 126.5-127.5°E, 37.1-38.0°N, from NASA Giovanni
